author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Join us as SpaceX rolls Super Heavy Booster 21 to Pad 2 ahead of Starship Flight 14.

B21 previously performed three cryogenic proofing tests on July 18th, 19th, and 20th. A scrub occurred before prop loading during Wednesday's test window.

Ship 41 has performed single-engine and six-engine static fires.
